title: Efficacy and Safety of the RD Regimen(Lenalidomide, Dexamethasone) for Rosai-Dorfman Disease
off: Efficacy and Safety of the RD Regimen (Lenalidomide, Dexamethasone) in the Treatment of Rosai-Dorfman Disease: A Prospective, Multicenter, Single-Arm Study.
sponsor: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
summary: In patients with Rosai-Dorfman disease (RDD), a treatment regimen of lenalidomide combined with dexamethasone is planned to be used.
desc: Patients received oral lenalidomide 25mg on days 1-21 and dexamethasone 40mg on days 1, 8, 15, 22, in 28-day cycles for 12 total cycles.

arms.d: Patients with RDD who are treatment-naive or have not previously received lenalidomide; aged 18-80 years; ECOG PS 0-2.

primary.tf: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 8 weeks
